description: Context Codec adapted long-session corpus (#971): each session carries planted commitments (goals, constraints, decisions, preferences, tool results, evidence, safety boundaries). Gates: critical atom recall >= 0.99, zero safety-boundary atoms lost, round-trip recoverability 1.0, and the fail-closed path exercised with an injected lossy compressor on every session.
